description: This file defines an ApiService class for managing communication between the frontend and backend services in a Flutter application. It handles various API requests such as fetching resources, posting logs, and retrieving tips, community threads, and plans related to health and wellness.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: A class acting as a client for backend API interactions, encapsulating endpoints for resources, logs, community, tips, fitness plans, meal plans, product recommendations, and AI feeding support.

methods.name: _safeGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified API path with error handling.

methods.name: _safePost
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the specified API path with given body and error handling.

methods.name: fetchResources
methods.description: Fetches a list of resource articles from the backend.

methods.name: submitDailyLog
methods.description: Submits a daily health/activity log entry to the backend.

methods.name: fetchCommunityThreads
methods.description: Retrieves community threads or chat rooms.

methods.name: fetchTips
methods.description: Gets personalized tips for the user.

methods.name: aiFeedingSupport
methods.description: Sends a question to the AI Feeding Support endpoint and retrieves a response.

methods.name: fetchMealPlans
methods.description: Fetches meal plans, including shopping list options.

methods.name: fetchRecommendedProducts
methods.description: Retrieves recommended products for mothers and babies.
